mainnet._comment: Rincoin mainnet. init = pre-v1.1.0 baseline parameters; activations[] = future, height-indexed overlays. Activation 0 height = 4 * nSubsidyHalvingInterval (4 * 210000 = 840000), aligned with the fourth halving boundary.

init._comment: init = pre-v1.1.0 baseline parameters; identical to the values that were hardcoded in chainparams.cpp / rinhash.cpp. No extra peer-protocol-version floor before activation 0 becomes effective.

activations._comment: Activation 0 turns on the v1.1.0 peer-protocol-version floor. PoW parameters are unchanged. From this height onward, peers advertising nVersion < 70018 are disconnected during the version handshake.

testnet._comment: Testnet. Activation 0 height = 4 * nSubsidyHalvingInterval (4 * 1050 = 4200) so functional tests reach it in seconds.

regtest._comment: Regtest. Activation 0 height = 4 * nSubsidyHalvingInterval (4 * 150 = 600) so regtest functional tests can sweep both regimes within a single run.

preview._comment: Previewnet (publicly reachable rehearsal network). Mirrors regtest's activation schedule (activation 0 height = 4 * nSubsidyHalvingInterval = 4 * 150 = 600) so operators can rehearse activation-0 behaviour on a real PoW network.
